Name: Primary space not selected
Trigger condition: Permit request submitted with no primary compartment
Clearing condition: A compartment is selected from the vessel register
Open question for the safety authority: None — mechanical.

Name: Coating active in certification set
Trigger condition: A spray/service coating ticket is OPEN in any space in the requesting activity’s certification set
Clearing condition: Coating ticket closed AND atmosphere re-tested by marine chemist
Open question for the safety authority: Does a mechanically isolated branch break the coupling, or only a physical blank?

Name: Hot work overhead of occupied space
Trigger condition: Hot work authorized on the deck directly above an occupied or combustible-loaded space
Clearing condition: Hot work complete AND post-work fire watch hold elapsed
Open question for the safety authority: Does the downward coupling extend two decks where a deck penetration exists?

Name: Coating starts while hot work live
Trigger condition: A coating ticket opens in a space coupled to an ALREADY ACTIVE hot work permit
Clearing condition: Coating closed and atmosphere re-tested; permit re-checked
Open question for the safety authority: Who wins on a race — is the later ticket refused, or the earlier one suspended? Current build suspends the earlier.

Name: Energised bus in work envelope
Trigger condition: Any intrusive work inside an electrical envelope whose bus is not in a verified zero-energy state
Clearing condition: Isolation performed, tags hung, zero-energy verified and recorded
Open question for the safety authority: Does a coupled bus segment two switchboards away require isolation, or notification only?

Name: Fire-watch credential invalid at request
Trigger condition: Bound fire watch has no valid, in-scope credential for the requested window
Authority document: NAVSEA hot work qualification standard; yard EHS
Clearing condition: A valid in-scope credential is bound to the permit
Open question for the safety authority: Is a credential expiring MID-window a refusal at request time, or a scheduled suspension?

Name: Coating cure on shared ventilation branch
Trigger condition: A coating cure is in progress in a space sharing the exhaust branch, but not the compartment
Clearing condition: Cure period elapsed and atmosphere re-tested
Open question for the safety authority: What work classes remain permitted under WARN? Build allows mechanical/hanging, refuses grinding, cutting, torch.

Name: Fire bottle out of test
Trigger condition: Selected extinguisher hydrostatic test date is in the past at the permit window
Clearing condition: An in-date bottle is selected or the bottle is re-tested
Open question for the safety authority: Is a bottle expiring inside the window a refusal, or a mid-shift swap requirement?

Name: ITP hold point open on pressure boundary
Trigger condition: A hold point requiring disposition is open on the activity or its predecessor
Clearing condition: Disposition recorded; second attest where required
Open question for the safety authority: Does an open hold point on a PREDECESSOR block fit-up, or only test?

Name: Flammables staged in coupled space
Trigger condition: Open solvent/flammable stow in a space on the same ventilation branch
Clearing condition: Stow secured OR vent boundary isolated and verified
Open question for the safety authority: Does a closed but unsecured stow count as secured?

Name: Crew challenge to a derived adjacency
Trigger condition: Crew asserts a model-derived coupling does not exist
Clearing condition: Approver rules on the challenge; register corrected if upheld
Open question for the safety authority: Who owns a correction to the adjacency graph, and what evidence is required?

Name: Waiver / departure from specification
Trigger condition: An approver requests relief from a rule outcome
Clearing condition: Waiver granted, scoped and time-boxed, by the cognizant authority
Open question for the safety authority: Which rules are waivable at all? Build assumes hazard cascades are NOT.

Name: Shift boundary reached
Trigger condition: Permit end time reached
Resulting state: SUSPEND if work in progress; COMPLETE if never started
Clearing condition: Re-initiation on the next shift re-runs every check
Open question for the safety authority: Confirm the split. Build completes unstarted permits and suspends live ones.

Name: Isolation invalidated mid-permit
Trigger condition: A coupled energy source is restored while a cold work permit is active
Clearing condition: Isolation re-verified and a new record filed
Open question for the safety authority: Does re-verification require a fresh walk, or does a control-room confirmation suffice?

Name: Permit window incomplete
Trigger condition: Date, shift, watch or bottle not chosen
Clearing condition: All four chosen and mutually consistent
Open question for the safety authority: None — mechanical.

Name: Pre-work site evidence missing
Trigger condition: No site photo (or, in a secure space, no completed two-signature attestation) before routing
Clearing condition: Photo captured, or attestation signed by two credentialed persons
Open question for the safety authority: Is a two-person attestation acceptable in lieu of photographic OQE in a secure space?

Name: Approval attempted past a live block
Trigger condition: Any approver attempts to approve a permit the engine holds at BLOCK
Clearing condition: The underlying rule clears
Open question for the safety authority: Confirm no persona may override. Build assumes none.

Name: Hold point not dispositioned at close-out
Trigger condition: Close-out attempted with an open ITP hold point; or a disposition signed on a lapsed credential
Clearing condition: Disposition recorded by a valid credential; second attest where required
Open question for the safety authority: Does a REJECT re-arm adjacent certifications? Build says yes.

Name: Stop work by inspection authority
Trigger condition: Fire Marshal or QA records STOP WORK on live work
Authority document: Yard safety programme; NAVSEA stop-work authority
Clearing condition: Condition cleared and re-checked like any suspension
Open question for the safety authority: Confirm QA holds stop-work authority, or restrict to Fire Marshal.

Name: Self-witness on a secure-space attestation
Trigger condition: The credential offered as witness already carries the first signature
Clearing condition: A different credentialed person witnesses
Open question for the safety authority: Must the witness hold a specific level, or is any credentialed person acceptable?
